_doc: A dead defender's phone (Phase 8 M9; research/operators/dokkaebi.md §3, gadgets/DESIGN.md §9): the server drops one on the floor where an eliminated defender's body fell (Skopós's is his circuit board, research/operators/skopos.md §4: the same rules). Never carried (`dropped`: its `count` and `use` are unused). Any damage destroys it (a bullet, the knife, a blast), from either team: his teammates shoot it to keep Dokkaebi off their cameras (a pre-remaster rule we keep). Her tablet hacks each one once, from anywhere (data/gadgets/jegeo_payload.json `jegeo`). An EMP does nothing to it (ours). Its size is a placeholder.
name: Phone
